tldr: Pluto in the 6th house: power becomes personal through work, health, routines, service, maintenance, and stress.
body:
With Pluto in the 6th house, this part of you intensifies work, health, routines, service, maintenance, and stress. Pluto describes power, pressure, truth, control, fear, attachment, and deep change. In practice, this brings attention to the daily habits, tasks, workloads, and body signals that decide how sustainable life feels.

When this placement is supported, your days can become more honest, supportive, and manageable. Pluto can become depth, honesty, resilience, and the ability to face what has been buried.

When it is strained, stress can become normal simply because you have learned how to function through it. The harder pattern can show up as control, obsession, compulsion, or trying to force an outcome that needs to change.
gift: depth, honesty, resilience, and the ability to face what has been buried expressed through work, health, routines, service, maintenance, and stress.
challenge: control, obsession, compulsion, or trying to force an outcome that needs to change around work, health, routines, service, maintenance, and stress.
